title: Analysis Quick Reference Guides | NHSN | CDC
content: Patient Safety Analysis Quick Reference Guides Print Minus Related Pages These quick reference guides were created to help you understand, modify, and interpret your data using the NHSN application’s various analysis output (report) options for the NHSN Patient Safety Component. These guides serve as companions to the “Introduction to NHSN Analysis” training slideset.
